notes: Getting paid: your vendor number, remit-to address, tax ID and payment terms on every invoice (Administration, Billing details); invoices take any number of payments with the date received, write-offs with a reason, and can be closed as Denied or Void with their work released to be invoiced again; work outside an authorization's dates, hours or dollars is refused until it is amended; tracks can be VR, private pay (invoiced to the client) or no charge. Includes 3.0.33 (System health) and 3.0.32. Apply dist/migrations/mig_3.0.34.sql before updating files (adds the payments table and billing columns; safe to re-run). Sites below 3.0.31 also apply mig_3.0.31.sql; Apply dist/migrations/mig_3.0.31.sql (confirms client emails waiting for confirmation). Sites below 3.0.28 apply mig_3.0.28.sql (adds scheduled_sessions.checked_in_at) before updating files; sites below 3.0.27 apply mig_3.0.27.sql first. Sites on 3.0.16 to 3.0.20 apply mig_3.0.21.sql first. Older sites apply mig_3.0.8, 3.0.9, 3.0.10, 3.0.12, 3.0.16, 3.0.21, 3.0.27, 3.0.28, 3.0.31 and 3.0.34 in order; all are safe to re-run.
